propositions: Git 2.38+ (merge-tree --write-tree capability) is not explicitly declared or enforced, allowing under-floor clients to run tests that silently do not execute.
The two-clone enrichment regression for bug 8185 requires git merge-tree --write-tree but lacks a guard, creating risk of vacuous test coverage if the capability is unavailable.
A skip guard on under-floor clients is worse than a hard version floor because it causes the regression to silently not run, defeating its coverage intent (similar to 34c2 pagination guard rot).
Git version floor must be single-sourced, consistently documented across README/CONTRIBUTING/docs, enforced in CI, and fail the entire test session (not skip individual tests) on violation.
The 8185 regression and related two-clone union tests must remain executed on all gating CI environments without conditional skip machinery.
